title: Trial of Lumo
summary: Learn the rhythm of Shenic combat and open the road to Blood Grove.

chain.title: Chapter I — First Blood
chain.description: Establish your first build, cross Lumo and Blood Grove, then break the Goblin Gate.
chain.goal: Reach level 10 and defeat the boss of Goblin Mines I.
chain.promisedReward: Choose one of three guaranteed Essences for your second slot.

objectives.description: Win 4 encounters in Lumo Ruins to prove your first build can hold the line.
Reach character level 5 to unlock Blood Grove.
